report_summary: The report offers many concrete coordination and moderation citations but repeatedly upgrades them into conclusive provider attribution, successful XSS, known harness configuration and measured cleanup labor. It quotes seed-fit uncertainty while elsewhere calling the generator cracked. Several precise chronology and recurrence claims require correction despite useful actual relay and overwrite evidence.
